response.what_it_is: Used IBC totes / plastic chemical storage tanks in metal cages
hidden_risks: Leaks or cracks in the inner plastic container
Damaged or stuck bottom discharge valve
Rust and structural integrity of the outer metal cage
response.best_proof: Close-up photo of the interior condition, bottom valve, and any warning or grade labels
response.failure_mode: Mistaking used industrial IBC tanks for brand-new containers or failing to account for hazardous chemical contamination risks.
